theorems.name: Submission.dtc_rescaled_ball_measure_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ) (lams : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal θ)) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (s : Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet s → μs j s = ENNReal.ofReal ((lams j)⁻¹ ^ n) * μ (dilation x (lams j) ⁻¹' s)) → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun j => μs j (ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * ENNReal.ofReal θ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
